scope: Theorem 3.1 (Adjoint-positivity input) of the manuscript “Orbifold and logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity” (preprints/Orbifold-and-logarithmic-Iitaka-subadditivity-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 033 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b143366cc99615e1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 17-18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let B be a smooth compact connected manifold in class C and B◦ ⊂ B a dense Zariski open set with SNC complement. Let V be a pure real-polarizable variation of Hodge structures on B◦ with an integral ambient lattice. Suppose a complex direct summand of VC has a rank-one highest nonzero Hodge step, with parabolic rational extension L. There are a modification τ : B′ → B, a surjective morphism p : B′ → S with connected fibers to a smooth projective variety, and a nef rational line bundle P on S such that (3.1) τ∗ L = p∗ P, KS + aP is big for some a ∈ Q>0. 18 OPENAI Positive rational rescaling of L is allowed, and the line identity persists under further modifica- tions. If S is a point, τ∗L is rationally trivial.
